name: Dragon Detective: A Friend from the Shadows
source: When a pair of strangers arrive at his home late one night, Detective Noxley reluctantly emerges from his self-imposed exile. What he uncovers next will put him at the center of a conflict that will change the future of his entire nation.
translation: 一天深夜，两个陌生人来到他家，诺克斯利警探不情愿地从自我放逐中走出来。他接下来发现的事情将使他处于一场冲突的中心，这场冲突将改变他整个国家的未来。
